verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item addresses AI-training data usage, opt-out controls, or a privacy/data-processing policy regarding model training; GitBook's AI features (search, assistant, MCP servers) are documented but nothing states whether user content is used to train models or how to prevent it. missing for 10: explicit privacy policy or setting for opting out of AI training, documentation on data usage for model training, third-party confirmation of this control.
